battle.name: 豐利山之戰
battle.brief: 開皇元年（581）春，隋文帝楊堅執掌北周，與北方突厥在陝北豐利山交戰，隋軍大破之。此役勝負繫於騎射、床弩與發石車一類器械，羅馬扭力弩砲並未參戰，卡面兵器在此只是同類投射火力的古代標本與對照物。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在北周末年、隋朝立國的那一年，時為開皇元年（辛丑，581）。名分上仍是北周朝廷對外用兵，實際調度卻已歸大丞相、隋王楊堅一人：前一年（庚子，580）他先平尉遲迥於鄴城、再平王謙於蜀地，關中與關東的宿衛、府兵與倉儲都換了主人，開皇元年正月進封隋王，同年十一月接受周恭帝宇文闡的禪讓，改元開皇。開國一方的軍隊骨幹是鎮守邊州的宿衛兵，加上臨時徵發的鄉兵與器械隊，部署在長城沿線、黃河各渡口以及關中北面的幾個山口，後方以洛陽、長安兩處倉儲與渭水、黃河的漕運供應；北面的草原聯盟，漢文史料稱之為突厥，汗庭以弓騎為絕對主力，控弦人數以百萬計，沒有大型攻城器具，作戰以季節性深入的掠奪、擾邊與游走為常態，極少在堅固正面與中原軍隊硬撞。雙方的差距不在裝備，而在組織與續戰能力：隋一方能把兵糧集中到一點，突厥一方卻能在數千里內快速集散。就編制與番號而言，此役的細節傳世史籍只剩數語，下面寫的是依制度與地理可以確定的部分。
countriesEn: This war was fought in the last year of Northern Zhou, the year the Sui was founded, that is Kaihuang 1 (xinchou, 581). Nominally it was still the Northern Zhou court that campaigned abroad, but the actual direction of everything lay with the grand chancellor and Prince of Sui, Yang Jian: in the year before (gengzi, 580) he had first destroyed Yuchi Jiong at Ye and then Wang Qian in Shu, so the garrisons, the fubing and the depots of both Guanzhong and Guandong had changed hands; in the first month of Kaihuang 1 he was raised to Prince of Sui, and in the eleventh month of the same year he received the abdication of the Zhou child-emperor Yuwen Chan and changed the era to Kaihuang. The backbone of the founding side was the garrison troops holding the frontier prefectures, reinforced by levies of local militia and by the train of engines, posted along the frontier wall, at the crossings of the Yellow River and at several passes north of the Guanzhong basin, while behind them the depots of Luoyang and Chang'an and the canal traffic of the Wei and Yellow rivers supplied the army. On the northern side stood the steppe confederation that Chinese sources call the Turks, whose court rested on mounted archers to an absolute degree, with the number of men able to draw a bow counted in hundreds of thousands, no large siege engines at all, and whose way of war was seasonal penetration, plunder, harassment and movement, rarely a head-on collision with a Chinese army on firm ground. The gap between the two sides lay not in equipment but in organisation and in the ability to keep fighting: the Sui side could concentrate men and grain on a single point, while the Turks could gather and disperse across a thousand li. As for order of battle and the names of the formations, the historical record preserves only a few words, and what follows is what can be established from institutions and geography.
people: 楊堅是這場戰爭裡唯一能夠確定的關鍵人物。北周宣帝暴崩、宇文闡年幼即位之後，他以大丞相身份攬下軍政大權，前一年先平尉遲迥、再平王謙，把北方的兩場大反抗壓回原位；開皇元年正月進封隋王，同年春天北疆再燃戰火時，他已經是一個有實戰紀錄、有邊防經驗的人，而不是靠著血緣取得權位的傀儡。隋軍在北線的將領，傳世記載多不具名；同一批人裡，主持開皇元年伐陳的高熲、掌尚書與內史兩省文樞的蘇威，都是這個班底的核心，可以看出北線的戰事與關東的攻勢在同一年並行。草原一方，主政的是都藍可汗，他當時正集中力量向西攻擊西突厥的阿波可汗，汗庭內部的裂痕才是隋朝得以插手北疆的縫隙；隋朝在日後扶植起來的啟民可汗，此時還只是草原聯盟裡一個受壓迫的小勢力，西突厥的阿波與後來的沙缽略則各自捲在這場內鬥裡。至於雙方在戰場上的實際指揮者，史料留下的是一片空白。
peopleEn: Yang Jian is the only person in this war whose role can be established with certainty. After the sudden death of the Zhou emperor and the accession of the child Yuwen Chan, he had taken the military and civil authority as grand chancellor; the year before he had broken Yuchi Jiong and then Wang Qian, pushing the two great rebellions of the north back into place. Raised to Prince of Sui in the first month of Kaihuang 1, and with the northern frontier flaring up again in the spring of that year, he was already a man with a record of campaigns and of frontier experience rather than a puppet raised by blood. The Sui commanders on the northern line are mostly unnamed in the surviving record; in the same team, Gao Jiong, who directed the campaign against Chen in the first year of Kaihuang, and Su Wei, who ran the document hub of the two ministries of Shangshu and Neishi, were the core, which shows that the northern war and the eastern offensive ran side by side in the same year. On the steppe side the ruler was the qaghan, Dulan, who at that moment was concentrating his strength against Abuo, the qaghan of the Western Turks; the fissure inside the steppe court was the crack through which the Sui could reach into the northern frontier. Qimin, the qaghan the Sui would later install, was at this time only a small and pressed group within the confederation, while Abuo of the west and the later Shabieluo were both caught in that internal struggle. As for the actual commanders on the field, the record leaves a blank.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）在它自己的體系裡並不是野戰主力，而是隨軍器械隊的成員：羅馬人在攻城與守城中把它架在城頭、營壘缺口和路口，用來壓制對方弓手、封鎖通道、掩護步兵壓上，較小的蠍式弩砲可以由小隊抬著走，較重的拋石機則要靠牛車拖曳，發射節奏緩慢而單發精度高，一發便是一支粗重的木鐵箭。開皇元年的關中沒有羅馬人，也沒有扭力蓄能的投射機，隋軍在同一位置上的對應器械是床弩（強弩）、發石車、撞車、飛雲、雲梯與巢車一類；床弩與發石車的傳統可以上溯到魏晉，當時的改良仍留有記載可循，《三國志》所收的馬鈞改進發石車、諸葛亮損益連弩即是代表。弩兵以跪姿或坐姿發射，單兵弩與立式床弩配合，覆蓋正面百步上下到二百步的範圍；步軍結陣之後，才輪到雲梯與撞車貼上城牆，發石車則用來打擊城頭與密集隊形。突厥一方完全沒有這類重裝器械，全部火力集中在馬上的角弓、骨鏃與撒在地面上的拒馬，兵卒多不著重甲，靠速度與騎射換取戰果；糧秣靠馬匹與乳酪隨軍攜帶，沒有攻城也沒有圍城，因此這套裝備體系永遠不會出現在草原上。
kitsEn: The Roman bolt-shooter on this card, the Scorpio, was not a main instrument of field combat in its own system but a member of the army's train of engines: the Romans set it on ramparts, on gaps in camp works and at road junctions during sieges and defences, to pin down opposing archers, seal a passage and cover infantry pressing forward. The smaller scorpio could be carried by a small squad, the heavier stone-throwers had to be dragged by ox-cart, and the firing rhythm was slow with high single-shot accuracy, one shot being one heavy wooden bolt with an iron head. There were no Romans in the Guanzhong basin in Kaihuang 1 and no torsion-powered engines either; the Sui equivalents in the same role were the strong crossbow bed on a frame, the stone-thrower, the ram, the flying cloud, the scaling ladder and the siege tower. The tradition of the bed crossbow and the stone-thrower runs back through the Wei and Jin, and the refinements of the period are still traceable in the record, such as the improvements to the stone-thrower attributed to Ma Jun and the modification of the repeating crossbow attributed to Zhuge Liang preserved in the Records of the Three Kingdoms. Crossbowmen fired kneeling or seated, light and heavy pieces combining to cover a frontage of roughly one hundred to two hundred paces; only after the infantry had closed into formation did the ladders and rams go up against the wall, while the stone-throwers worked on the ramparts and on packed formations. The Turks had no heavy engines of this kind at all: their entire firepower sat in the composite bow and bone arrow on horseback and in caltrops thrown on the ground, their soldiers mostly wore no heavy armour, and they won by speed and shooting from the saddle. Their provisions travelled with the horses and the dairy foods, and since they neither besieged nor blockaded, this whole equipment system never appeared on the steppe.
tactics: 因為戰鬥過程沒有留下逐日記載，戰術只能由三條線索推想：一是地形與季節，二是隋軍當時的野戰慣例，三是草原騎兵的行動方式。開春的陝北黃土高原氣溫尚低、風沙大，草原騎兵最擅長的就是在這種開闊地帶迂迴逼近，再突然散開成漫天箭雨；中原軍隊的常規是結陣而進，步兵居中結方陣，弩手列於陣前，兩翼配騎兵，器械隊在後就地展開。隋軍出長城線南下，據險要山口布防，把戰場主動權握在手上，逼突厥騎兵在不利於機動的谷地裡作戰。追擊與決戰的過程在史籍裡只留有「追奔」一類的詞，可見戰局很快從對峙翻成崩潰：隋軍在山道上以弩陣壓住騎兵衝鋒的通路，待其隊形散亂，再以騎兵自兩翼壓上，終於在豐利山一線擊潰對手。糧道是這場戰役真正的弱點：關中出兵所賴的糧秣多數自洛陽與長安的倉儲轉運，渭水與黃河的漕運加上驛道接力，數百里路要走上一個月，一旦戰線拉長，補給就會成為負擔；突厥則沒有這個問題，馬匹與乳酪便可隨軍供給。
tacticsEn: Since no day-by-day narrative of the fighting survives, the tactics can be reconstructed from three clues: the ground and the season, the standing field practice of the Sui army, and the way steppe cavalry moved. In the early spring the loess plateau of northern Shaanxi is still cold and windy, and that open country is exactly where steppe horsemen were at their best, closing by wide sweeps and then suddenly spreading out into a shower of arrows. The Chinese way of war was to advance in formation, infantry closed into a solid block in the centre, crossbowmen posted in front, cavalry on the wings and the engine train deployed in the rear once the line had settled. The Sui army came down off the frontier wall, took up position at a commanding defile and kept the initiative, forcing the Turk horsemen to fight in ground where their mobility was useless. The pursuit and the decision are left in the record only by a word such as the rush of the beaten; the collapse was fast, and the Sui line used its crossbow ranks on the mountain track to seal the path of the charge, waited for the enemy formation to open, and then pressed with cavalry on both wings, finally breaking the opponent on the line of Mount Fenglei. Supply was the real weakness of this campaign: the grain on which the Guanzhong army depended was drawn from the depots of Luoyang and Chang'an, moved by the waterways of the Wei and the Yellow River and relayed along the post road, a distance of several hundred li that took a month to work through, and once the line of operations was stretched, supply became a burden. The Turks had no such problem, since horses and dairy provisions travelled with them.
data: 這一役的數字必須分成兩類看。戰役本身的數字幾乎全缺：《隋書》與《資治通鑑》在此事上只留數語，既沒有雙方兵力的確數，也沒有可以核對的損失記載；史書中常見的「斬首萬餘級」「得男女數萬口」一類概括，屬於編纂者的量級描述，不能當作確數引用，本篇因此不列具體人數。可以引用的是制度與地理的量級。其一，《隋書·突厥傳》記草原聯盟控弦之士以百萬計，說明對手的戰爭動員遠大於關中，這場仗只是它每年數次入塞中的一場。其二，《隋書·高祖紀》記開皇元年二月置三所屯田、給牛二十萬頭以給軍士，反映當時軍糧供應仍靠屯田與轉運並舉，邊軍的消耗由關中共同分擔。其三，豐利山的地望在後世地理書中說法不一，多繫於陝北山地與河套之間，並無定論；本篇採用「陝北豐利山」的寬泛說法，經緯度取陝北一帶的代表點。其四，羅馬弩砲的有效射程約在百數十步，隋代床弩的覆蓋距離也在二百步上下，兩者同處於「覆蓋正面、壓制射線」的量級，說明這個位置的技術門檻並不高。其五，時間上，開皇元年春是北疆的傳統出警季節，而戰役的具體月份與持續日數沒有可靠記載。
dataEn: The figures of this battle have to be sorted into two kinds. The figures of the battle itself are almost entirely missing: in the Book of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror both leave only a few words, with no reliable count of the troops on either side and no verifiable account of losses. The rounded expressions that do appear, such as so many thousand heads cut off or so many thousand persons taken, belong to the compiler's sense of scale and cannot be quoted as exact numbers, so no headcount is given here. What can be quoted are the magnitudes of institutions and geography. First, the Book of Sui in the biography of the Turks records the confederation's men able to draw a bow in the hundreds of thousands, which shows how much larger the enemy's mobilisation was than that of the Guanzhong basin; this was one campaign among several the Turks made into the border every year. Second, the annals of the founding emperor in the Book of Sui record that in the second month of Kaihuang 1 three military farms were established and two hundred thousand head of oxen assigned to feed the soldiers, which shows that grain was still supplied by farming and transport together and that the cost of the frontier army was shared across the whole basin. Third, the location of Mount Fenglei is treated differently in later geographical works, most of them placing it between the northern Shaanxi hills and the Ordos loop, with no agreement; this account uses the broad description northern Shaanxi, Mount Fenglei, with coordinates taken from a representative point in that area. Fourth, the effective range of the Roman bolt-shooter was on the order of a hundred or a few hundred paces, and the reach of the Sui bed crossbow was around two hundred paces, both belonging to the same class of engagement, covering a frontage and suppressing the enemy's shooting line, which shows that the technical threshold of this role was not high. Fifth, in time, the spring of Kaihuang 1 was the traditional season of alarms on the northern frontier, while the exact month of the battle and the number of days it lasted are not reliably recorded.
cause: 開打的原因有三層。最外層是草原的年度性壓力：塞北的畜牧經濟在夏秋之後需要補充，馬匹、牲畜與俘獲都要從南方取得，於是入塞掠奪邊州是汗庭每年都要做的功課，581年只是其中一次，而且這類戰事往往由對方先挑釁。往裡一層是楊堅本人的政治需要：他前一年剛平掉尉遲迥與王謙兩場叛亂，新建立的權威需要一次乾淨的邊境勝利來證明，而對手又恰好是一個可以挑來打的邊外強權——它能打，但打不贏一場被集中起來的進攻。再往裡是草原聯盟自身的分裂：都藍可汗與西突厥的阿波可汗正在互相攻殺，隋朝正好看準這道縫隙，把對手的內部矛盾變成自己的戰術前提，用邊界的勝利去換取之後在漠北安置自己人的資本。至於最深處的原因則是體制：北周末年府兵制已廢弛多年，邊防靠臨時徵發，戶口與兵源正是楊堅急著要重新整理的東西，一場邊戰正好用來試探新制度的成色，也用來篩選願意跟著新朝廷走的將領。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost was the annual pressure of the steppe: after summer and autumn the pastoral economy of the north needed replenishing, and horses, livestock and captives all had to come from the south, so raiding the border prefectures was a yearly task of the steppe court, and 581 was one of them; such raids were usually begun by the other side. One layer further in lay Yang Jian's own political need: the year before he had put down the two great rebellions of Yuchi Jiong and Wang Qian, and the authority he had just built needed one clean frontier victory to prove itself, while the opponent happened to be a power beyond the border that could be picked on as a target, strong enough to fight, never strong enough to beat a concentrated attack. Deeper still was the division inside the steppe confederation itself: the qaghan Dulan and the western qaghan Abuo were striking at each other, and the Sui watched for exactly that crack, converting an enemy quarrel into its own tactical premise and trading a victory on the border for the capital it would later place on the empty steppe. At the bottom lay an institutional problem: the fubing system had been decaying for years at the end of Northern Zhou, the frontier was held by ad hoc levies, and the households and the man-power were exactly what Yang Jian was in a hurry to sort out; a border war was a convenient way to test the new system and to see which commanders would follow the new court.
impact: 就眼前的結果而言，豐利山一役為隋朝在北疆取得了第一個明確的邊境勝利，陝北的門戶重新安定下來，這讓楊堅在同年十一月取代北周時多了一份可以攤開來講的軍功與邊防信用。從長遠看，這場戰爭真正改變的是隋朝對北疆的整套辦法：既然正面打贏了，朝廷便不必年年防守，而可以把手伸進草原——開皇年間隋朝扶植啟民可汗、分化西突厥、把阿波與沙缽略之間的矛盾當成武器用，都可以在豐利山之後的幾年裡一一落地，開皇三年的白道之戰、啟民可汗重返汗庭都屬於同一條線上的後續動作，而這條線的起點正是這場邊境勝利。戰術層面上，隋代在弩機與攻城器械上的記載也更完整地留存下來，讓後人得以把魏晉以來的中原工程傳統與草原騎兵對壘的實際需要放在一起看。至於卡面的羅馬弩砲，它在這條線上並沒有任何角色：它屬於另一個地中海世界的技術譜系，在這場戰爭裡只能作為投射火力如何被安置的一個古代標本。
impactEn: In the short run, the battle of Mount Fenglei gave the Sui its first clear frontier victory on the northern border, the approaches of northern Shaanxi were settled again, and Yang Jian could lay a record of military merit and frontier competence on the table when he replaced Northern Zhou in the eleventh month of that same year. In the longer run what the war really changed was the entire way the Sui handled the northern frontier: having won a frontal battle, the court no longer had to defend every year and could reach into the steppe instead. The installation of the qaghan Qimin, the splitting of the Western Turks, the use of the quarrel between Abuo and Shabieluo as a weapon — all of these could be carried out in the years after Mount Fenglei, and the battle of White Way in the third year of Kaihuang and the return of Qimin to the steppe belong to the same line of policy, and that line starts from this frontier victory. At the level of tactics, the Sui record of crossbow machines and siege engines has also come down more completely, so that later readers can set the engineering tradition of the Wei and Jin against the actual requirements of meeting steppe cavalry. As for the Roman bolt-shooter on the card, it plays no part on this line at all: it belongs to the technical family of a different Mediterranean world, and in this war it can only stand as an ancient specimen of how projectile firepower was placed.
result: 打完的結局是清楚的：隋軍在豐利山一線擊潰了草原聯盟的一支部隊，邊境重新回到可控的狀態，對手退往塞北；同年，楊堅接受周恭帝宇文闡的禪讓，建立隋朝，改元開皇，北周從此結束。但過程的細節無法復原：交戰的具體日期、雙方的實際兵力、戰場的精確位置、追擊了多少里、斬獲與俘虛的數目，傳世史籍都沒有留下可核的記載，能確定的只是「隋軍勝、對手退、邊境安」這一組結果，這也說明這場戰役在後世編年裡長期被壓縮成一行字。另外有一點必須交代清楚：把這場戰爭繫於開皇元年（581）是後世年表的慣例，具體月份、豐利山的今地以及交戰雙方的番號，至今仍有異說；較穩健的表述是，它是一次發生在北周與隋交替的那一年、隋（北周）一方對北方游牧勢力的邊境決戰，規模不大，但位置關鍵，而它留下的最大遺產，是一套在北疆由守轉攻的辦法，隋朝在草原上後來的所有動作都從這裡分岔出去。
resultEn: The outcome of the fighting is clear: the Sui army broke a body of the steppe confederate on the line of Mount Fenglei, the border returned to a controllable state, and the opponent withdrew north of the frontier; in the same year Yang Jian accepted the abdication of the Zhou child-emperor Yuwen Chan, founded the Sui and changed the era to Kaihuang, and Northern Zhou came to an end. The details of the process cannot be reconstructed: the exact date of the engagement, the actual strength on both sides, the precise position of the field, how many li the pursuit ran, and the numbers of those cut off and taken are all without verifiable record, and the only certain result is the set of a Sui victory, an enemy withdrawal and a settled border. That is also why this campaign has been compressed into a single line in later chronologies. One further point must be made explicit: attaching this war to Kaihuang 1 (581) is the convention of later annals, while the exact month, the modern location of Mount Fenglei and the names of the formations on both sides remain disputed. The steadier statement is that this was a border decision fought by the Sui (that is, Northern Zhou) side against a northern nomadic power in the very year when Zhou gave way to Sui, small in scale but critical in position; and the greatest inheritance it left was a method of northern frontier policy that turned from defence to attack, from which every later Sui move on the steppe branched out.
